notes: Single-throttle-body V7 II, V9 and the 2012-on V7. Uses throttle self-learning rather than a TPS reset, and has no CO trim. Target throttle readings: 0.9-1.0 degrees for V7/V7 III/V9, 1.0-1.2 for V7 II. Live local identifiers for this family have not been captured yet. Run the read-only identifier discovery scan and contribute the result; until then the workstation offers identification, DTCs and raw discovery only.

memory.write_blocked_reason: Handled by IAWMIUG3Writer; no verified fixtures in this project.

routines.name: Throttle self-learning
routines.description: MIU G3 equivalent of the TPS reset. Ignition on, engine off.
routines.follow_up: Check the throttle angle lands in the model's target band (0.9-1.2 degrees), then re-check idle.
